workers.P1: minimal attributes, adjunct labels and scoped accessibility CSS
workers.P2: bounded semantic subtree repairs and verified root-cause dependency graph
workers.P3: new accessible HTML design from source purpose, description, category, URL and capture; no imposed template
workers.P4: new accessible HTML design from verified Markdown and contextual reference evidence; no imposed template
workers.P5: closed selection among admissible P1-P4/model actions or stop

judges.status: integrated; development plumbing and coverage checked; expert agreement unvalidated

selection.context: page profile, measured within-run feedback and remaining resources
selection.skill_updates: evidence-backed revision, passed tests and explicit new runtime freeze

preservation: Measured source content/control/DOM/layout fidelity for all levels; not an acceptance gate. P1/P2 generator scope remains conservative/coordinated; P3/P4 design is free.
acceptance: Current diagnostic mode measures imperfect proposals and selects the best actual remediation. Usability, visual review and fidelity provide feedback and reported outcomes. Typed operations, source identity, monetary limits and the attempt cap remain deterministic.
